title: House prosecutors ready to cross-examine Sara Duterte if she takes witness stand
summary: The House prosecution panel is prepared to cross-examine Vice President Sara Duterte if she decides to take the witness stand in her Senate impeachment trial.

blocks.text: The House prosecution panel is prepared to cross-examine Vice President Sara Duterte if she decides to take the witness stand in her Senate impeachment trial.
At a news forum on Saturday, House prosecutor Manila Representative Joel Chua said the prosecution team is expecting a "surprise witness" in the upcoming trial next week.
"Inaasahan ng panel of prosecutors na magdadag sila ng witness dahil apat 'yung trial dates na December 1 to 4 pero 'yung witnesses na kanilang ipi-present ay dadalawa lamang," Chua said.
(The panel of prosecutors is expecting they will add more witnesses because there are four trial dates upcoming from December 1 to 4 but they are about to present only two witnesses.)
Chua added that a "surprise witness" might be "in the person of the respondent, the honorable vice president."

The vice president's team had asked the Senate impeachment court for the issuance of subpoenas to two witnesses, namely Cale88's Lourdes Lebosada, the alleged business partner of Duterte's husband Atty. Manases Carpio; and Agaton Teodoro Uvero, deputy commissioner for the Bureau of Customs' Assessment and Operations Coordinating Group.

"But in any event, handa po kami, handa po ang panel of prosecutors at kung sakali naman po na uupo ang ating bise presidente bilang testigo ng defense ay nakahanda po kami na i-cross [examine]…," Chua said.
(But in any event, we are ready, the panel of prosecutors is ready. And if the vice president testifies for the defense, we are ready to cross examine her.)
This came after Duterte said she had asked her legal team to allow her to lawyer for herself in the impeachment trial, but her defense counsel Michael Poa supposedly ignored this.
"Handa kami na i-cross examine ang ating Bise Presidente. In fact may naka-assign na po na abogado in the event na siya ang umupo sa witness stand," Chua said.
The House prosecutor said that prosecution panel is preparing all possibilities, including Carpio also taking the witness stand.
"Lahat naman 'yan possibility kaya hindi 'yan tinatanggal sa table," Chua said.
The impeachment trial is tackling the sole remaining charge of unexplained wealth against Duterte after the prosecution team dropped all other three articles of impeachment.

The vice president earlier said she and her defense team are always "preparing for the worst" now that the trial is nearing its end and the Senate impeachment court is expected to issue a verdict soon, as she reiterated that she would not be stepping down from office amid her impeachment trial. — VDV, GMA News
